title: Life Time Austin Rattler Brings Mountain Biking and Trail Running Together for 14th Year
summary: More than 1,200 athletes from 39 states and 8 countries gathered in Texas Hill Country for a two-day celebration of off-road endurance sports, with trail running participation up 58% since 2021...
body_markdown:
*More than 1,200 athletes from 39 states and 8 countries gathered in Texas Hill Country for a two-day celebration of off-road endurance sports, with trail running participation up 58% since 2021*


AUSTIN, Texas


, Nov. 16, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Life Time](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823929-1&h=1124216609&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2F%3Futm_source%3Dchatgpt.com&a=Life+Time) (NYSE: LTH), the nation's premier healthy way of life brand, welcomed more than 1,200 athletes from 39 states and 8 countries to the 14th annual[Life Time Austin Rattler MTB & Run](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823929-1&h=4187446873&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.austinrattler.com%2F&a=Life+Time+Austin+Rattler+MTB+%26+Run) this weekend at Reveille Peak Ranch in the Texas Hill Country. For the first time, mountain biking and trail running competitions spanned two days, Saturday and Sunday, creating a full weekend experience for athletes and their friends and families.


The event's continued growth reflects increasing interest in off-road endurance sports, particularly trail running. Since 2021, participation in the running events at Austin Rattler has increased 58% across all distances, with the women's field growing 77% over the same period.


The expanded two-day format featured three distances for each discipline, with mountain bike participants taking on 20, 40 or 60 miles and trail runners originally scheduled to compete across 10-mile, 20-mile and 50K distances, creating opportunities for athletes of varying experience levels to participate. The looped course brought athletes back through the start and finish area throughout the day, giving support crews and spectators multiple opportunities to cheer on their runners and riders while enjoying live music, food and finish-line festivities.


Anticipated storms on Sunday prompted organizers to adjust the trail running schedule, including shortening the scheduled 50K distance, to prioritize athlete safety.


For Life Time, the Austin Rattler is another expression of its connection to the Austin community. With five athletic country clubs across the Austin market, Life Time serves as a destination for training, recovery and connection year-round, while its athletic events extend those experiences into the broader community. The event also offers a pathway to the company's iconic Life Time Leadville Trail 100 events, with the 60-mile mountain bike and 50K run – amended to a 20-mile course due to weather – serving as qualifiers for the 2027 editions in Colorado.


"We're seeing more people embrace the opportunity to get outside, challenge themselves and experience the community that comes with off-road endurance sports. The growth at Austin Rattler speaks to that momentum, and we're excited to continue creating opportunities for athletes of all experience levels to find their place on the trails," said Michelle Duffy, Vice President of Retail and Events at Life Time.


Now in its 14th year, the Austin Rattler is part of Life Time's portfolio of more than 30 iconic athletic events spanning road running, trail running, mountain biking and gravel cycling. Together, the events create experiences that unite competition, community and active living, welcoming people of different ages and abilities to pursue their goals and connect through movement.
